messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: routing.p99.us-west2 > 3000ms for 6m; SLO breach (p99). paging tyler_oncall. auto-opened incident INC-3623.

tyler_oncall: got it, joining bridge now. creating livebridge + #oncall-bridge. priority: P1.

maria_prodeng: seeing a sharp uptick in streaming stalls too — clients report sessions freezing at tail tokens. p95 ~850ms, p99 ~3200-3800ms for last 6m.

jess_sre: logs show ingress-router nodes with uneven distribution. top keys concentrating on shard 17 (hotkey ~payments:session:eu-prod-***). routing policy recently rolled (weighted-split-v2) ~30m ago. suspect policy bug + hot partition.

tyler_oncall: ok list of actions: 1) disable weighted-split-v2 2) enable eager-fallback on us-west2 3) divert 15% traffic to eu-fallback pool 4) evict/reshard hot shard 17. who can run the rollback?

jess_sre: i'll run the rollback. running command:```cli
redwood deploy routing-policy --env prod --policy weighted-split-v1 --target ingress-router-usw2
```

deploy-bot: STARTED: rollback routing-policy weighted-split-v1 -> targeted ingress-router-usw2 (run id: rk-7831).

sam_support: heads-up to CS: initial customer reports from streaming customers A-98, B-Cloud, and C-Media. potential impact: stalls/dropped frames. I've opened support tickets and escalated to account leads.

maria_prodeng: telemetry: KV-cache-hit rate unchanged; batch sizes stable. tail latency correlates with routing decisions (handoffs to router nodes with high queue depth). region affinity skew: us-west2 shows 62% of user traffic while expected ~28% for this slice.

jess_sre: rollback applied on 3 of 5 gateways. checking p99 now.

incident-bot: UPDATE: routing-policy rollback rk-7831: progress 60% -> routers 1-3 rolled, routers 4-5 pending.

tyler_oncall: after first rollback chunk: p99 dipped to ~1200ms but still high. starting evict on shard 17 to rebalance:```bash
curl -XPOST https://infra.internal/reshard -d '{"shard":17,"strategy":"evict_then_merge"}'
```

jess_sre: evict triggered, reshuffle in flight. also enabling eager-fallback flag for streams on us-west2:```yaml
feature_flags:
  streams_eager_fallback: true
```

maria_prodeng: quick analysis: the policy version had a bug where weights for sticky-hash were applied after regional-affinity calculation, causing extreme concentration in a small subset of shards. that explains hot partitioning + handoff thrashing. will capture in postmortem.

sam_support: confirmed CS notified 8 enterprise customers, asked them to route around if possible. adding mitigation note to tickets.

deploy-bot: DONE: rollback rk-7831 applied to all gateways.

jess_sre: post-rollback metrics: p95 ~220ms, p99 ~700-900ms, streaming stall rate decreased ~85%. still seeing occasional >1500ms outliers on a small subset (probably during reshuffle).

tyler_oncall: good. keep watch for 30m. next steps: full postmortem, patch routing-policy tests, add canary checks for regional skew, add an alert for shard hotness. owners: jess_sre (postmortem), maria_prodeng (policy patch), sam_support (customer comms).

maria_prodeng: naming notes for postmortem: root cause = routing-policy weight application order; contributing = lack of shard-hotness alert + canary that exercises global distribution.

jess_sre: I'll file INC-3623 follow-up and schedule a postmortem meeting. attaching quick logs snippet for later:
```text
2026-03-15T01:12:03Z ingress-router-3 route decision: policy=weighted-split-v2 user_key=payments:session:eu-prod-9f2 weight=0.8 -> selected shard=17 queue_depth=42
2026-03-15T01:12:03Z ingress-router-4 route decision: policy=weighted-split-v2 user_key=payments:session:eu-prod-9f2 weight=0.1 -> selected shard=17 queue_depth=47
```

sam_support: closed loop with affected accounts: escalation emails sent, we offered throughput increase + temporary regional pin for top 3. customers appreciated the proactive note.

tyler_oncall: closing bridge in 10m unless regressions. final status: mitigated but not fully remediated (postmortem & policy patch required).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-3623 status=mitigated -> monitoring. p99 now trending ~650ms over 5m.

jess_sre: volunteered to own postmortem doc. will include timeline, diffs, test additions, and backport to private deployments.

maria_prodeng: will draft policy patch and follow-up canary (region distribution check + shard-hotness threshold).

tyler_oncall: thanks all. tagging final assignees and moving to watch. :thumbsup:
